item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): The Building 101 page now shows that its…
item.description: The Building 101 page now shows that its size is reported differently (RH: about 80,000 sq ft; National Register: 56,268; Port: 61,311 before and 60,525 after rehabilitation) and its floors are described differently. It says RH announced the opening in a May 13, 2022 press release that gives no separate opening day, and that the 2013 Historic Preservation Commission memo lists lots for all ten historic buildings together. item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): RH's May 13, 2022 release gives the…
item.description: RH's May 13, 2022 release gives the opening date (the record had May 12) and describes a rooftop park and two wine bars, not a rooftop bar. The record no longer says the rehabilitation was complete in 2020 (the Port's January 2019 list of 2020 milestones was a forecast), and the site-wide December 2020 completion entry was removed. Building area is stated as RH's 80,000 sq ft for the whole building, not galleries; the January 2019 Port update is dated by its Jan 4 memo; the retired Assessor lot 4046001 is described as retired on 2018-10-02 rather than as the building's current lot; and an earlier change entry no longer says RH bought the building. RH San Francisco has not been re-confirmed as operating since 2022. Source: RH, press release, 2022-05-13 (https://ir.rh.com/news-events/detail/18/rh-announces-the-opening-of-rh-san-francisco-the-gallery-at-the-historic-bethlehem-steel-building); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 12A staff report, 2019-01-04 (https://www.sfport.com/media/4465/download); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): The eight-building Historic Core's $127M…
item.description: The eight-building Historic Core's $127M total rehabilitation cost (Port Item 12A, Jan 4, 2019, Table 2: $127.0 million; the memo's text says an estimated $125 million) had been copied identically onto the cost entries of Buildings 101, 102, 104, 113/116 and 14. It now appears once, in the shared site-wide cost list as a development cost for the Pier 70 Historic Core, with all five records pointing to it. Each building keeps its own hard-cost figure as a construction cost for that building. Source: https://www.sfport.com/media/4465/download.

item.title: Added · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): RH San Francisco (The Gallery at the Historic…
item.description: RH San Francisco (The Gallery at the Historic Bethlehem Steel Building) opened May 13, 2022 in Building 101, a showroom with the Palm Court restaurant, two wine bars and a rooftop park (RH press release, May 13, 2022). RH has subleased the building since February 2017 under a 41-year sublease (Port Item 12A, Jan 2019). Source: https://ir.rh.com/news-events/detail/18/rh-announces-the-opening-of-rh-san-francisco-the-gallery-at-the-historic-bethlehem-steel-building.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): Historic Shipyard at Pier 70… (~2023)
item.description: Historic Shipyard at Pier 70 Rehabilitation is among the 2023 Governor's Historic Preservation Awards (California Office of Historic Preservation; the summary covers 'a half dozen historic buildings known as "20th Street Historic Buildings at Pier 70"' and does not name Building 101, which is one of the master-leased 20th Street buildings; no ceremony date is given) (~2023). Source: California Office of Historic Preservation, 2023.

item.title: Complete · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): RH announces the opening of… (May 13, 2022)
item.description: RH announces the opening of RH San Francisco at 590 20th Street in the restored 80,000-square-foot building (RH's figure for the whole building): five floors, the Palm Court restaurant, two wine bars and a rooftop park. The release is dated May 13, 2022 and the trade outlet HomePage News reported on May 16, 2022 that the gallery 'has opened'; no source read gives the first day of business or a certificate-of-occupancy date (May 13, 2022). Source: RH (tenant's press release), 2022-05-13; HomePage News, 2022-05-16.

item.title: Complete · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): RH announces the opening of… (May 13, 2022)
item.description: RH announces the opening of RH San Francisco in Building 101 (press release dated this day; no separate opening day is given) (May 13, 2022). Source: https://ir.rh.com/news-events/detail/18/rh-announces-the-opening-of-rh-san-francisco-the-gallery-at-the-historic-bethlehem-steel-building.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): Port's Jan 2019 update lists… (~2020)
item.description: Port's Jan 2019 update lists 'Complete Building 101 rehabilitation and tenant improvements' among its 2020 milestones (a forecast; the report does not say it happened, and RH opened in May 2022) (~2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-01-04.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): Port staff update (memo dated… (Jan 4, 2019)
item.description: Port staff update (memo dated Jan 4, 2019): six of eight buildings complete, Buildings 101 and 102 still under construction, project 100% subleased except two atrium retail spaces; whole-Historic-Core project total costs (not the cost of this building alone) rose from $81.9M at 2014 approvals to $127.0M in Table 2's '2018, Actual' column, while the memo's text gives 'an estimated $125 million at project completion in 2020'; Table 2 marks one line (Building 102's $6.7M) as a future-expenditure estimate (Jan 4, 2019). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-01-04.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): Building 101 still under… (Jan 2019)
item.description: Building 101 still under construction with completion and occupancy anticipated in 2020; additions include a publicly accessible restaurant and rooftop terrace (Jan 2019). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-01-04.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): Permanent financing for the… (~Oct 2018)
item.description: Permanent financing for the Historic Core project achieved (~Oct 2018). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-01-04.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): RH sublease commences: entire… (Feb 2017)
item.description: RH sublease commences: entire building, 41-year term, PDR showroom and restaurant use (Feb 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-01-04.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): Restoration Hardware reported… (Feb 9, 2016)
item.description: Restoration Hardware reported as the Historic Core's first tenant, subleasing Building 101 from Historic Pier 70 LLC; design architect James Gillam of Backen, Gillam & Kroeger; opening then slated for 2017 (Feb 9, 2016). Source: Commercial Property Executive (Scott Baltic), 2016-02-09.

item.description: Port Commission endorses the Pier 70 Preferred Master Plan (Resolution 10-27), which calls for a National Register district and rehabilitation of the 20th Street buildings (May 11, 2010). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2019-01-04.

item.title: Existing · Pier 70 Building 101 (Bethlehem Steel HQ): Built as the Union Iron Works' new… (1917)
item.description: Built as the Union Iron Works' new main office building to Frederick H. Meyer's design, reported at a cost of $250,000 and 350 staff (1917). Source: National Park Service / California Office of Historic Preservation (nomination prepared for the Port of San Francisco by Carey & Co.), 2014-04-17.
